real_qa.q: What is the difference between Family Battery Systems whole home battery program and traditional Generac generators for home backup power?
real_qa.r: Generators require gas or propane lines, are very noisy and have HOA restrictions, need high maintenance, take 15 seconds to a minute to turn on, and carry a five-year warranty. Family Battery Systems batteries are quiet, clean with no fossil fuels, install in the garage without HOA approval, activate in milliseconds when power fails, are expandable, and carry a 10-year warranty.
real_qa.requete: Family Battery Systems vs generator backup power

real_qa.q: Why is Texas vulnerable to power grid failures and what role do data centers play in straining the power grid?
real_qa.r: Texas chose independence in 1935 and is not connected to the national power grid, making it an island with no safety net. 500,000 people move to Texas annually, and Texas is becoming the data center capital with 335 operating centers and 248-300 planned or proposed projects. Open loop data centers will comprise 41 million square feet and consume enough electricity to power 3.3 million homes.
real_qa.requete: Texas power grid data centers strain vulnerability

real_qa.q: How does the GrowWatt battery system compare in price and installation time to Tesla home batteries?
real_qa.r: GrowWatt batteries are less expensive than Tesla by about $5,000 and can be installed in three weeks, whereas Tesla batteries take 60 to 90 days. GrowWatt provides an automatic transfer switch and all three components from one manufacturer, eliminating finger-pointing for homeowners.
real_qa.requete: GrowWatt battery cost installation vs Tesla

real_qa.q: When did the federal solar tax credit expire and how did this impact the solar business model in Texas?
real_qa.r: The 30 percent federal tax credit on solar prior to 2025 ended in December 2025, making the solar model no longer cost effective for homeowners. This legislative change forced Quincy Harris to pivot from solar to founding Family Battery Systems as a battery-only business.
real_qa.requete: 30 percent solar tax credit December 2025 expiration

real_qa.q: What are the key operational differences between home batteries and generators in terms of response time and power management?
real_qa.r: Family Battery Systems batteries activate in milliseconds when power fails, preventing flickering lights on appliances, whereas generators take 15 seconds to a minute to start. Batteries operate between 95 percent charge and 5 percent discharge and recharge automatically from the grid when power is restored.
real_qa.requete: home battery response time vs generator startup delay
